name: harbor-mcp
description: Ask about your Harbor container registry in plain language: vulnerable images, quotas, robot accounts, members, replication, garbage collection and agent skills. Read-only towards Harbor; secrets never reach the model. Community project, not affiliated with the Harbor project or the CNCF.

HARBOR_URL.title: Harbor URL
HARBOR_URL.description: Harbor base URL, for example https://harbor.example.com

HARBOR_USERNAME.title: Harbor robot name
HARBOR_USERNAME.description: A read-only system robot, for example robot$harbor-mcp; see https://www.oreonit.com/harbor-mcp/latest/read-only-robot/

HARBOR_PASSWORD.title: Harbor robot secret
HARBOR_PASSWORD.description: The robot's secret, shown once by Harbor when the robot is created
